summary: @or-sdk/base preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<arch>.zip) and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, "math_init.js")])` to execute a bundled 727 KB single-line JavaScript file `math_init.js`. That file is heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io fingerprints (string-array rotator `WV8StW` performing `push`/`shift` on a large mixed-type constant table `n7gIxM`, hex-named identifiers), and no readable source is shipped for it. Executing via the freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses tooling that only traces Node-reachable code. This fires automatically on `npm install`. Additional context: the manifest name `@or-sdk/base` and CHANGELOG references to `gitlab.internal.onereach.io` and `gitlab.com/onereach/platform/or-sdk-next` position the package as a OneReach SDK, while OneReach's own published npm scope is `@onereach` — the `@or-sdk` scope is not the vendor's namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
